title: In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027, an XML external entity reference…
description: An XML external entity (XXE) vulnerability exists in In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027. This flaw occurs during SVG image processing, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to read local files on the server by submitting a crafted SVG image containing a nested embedded SVG. The vulnerability can be triggered when the image is processed or exported to PDF.
